products: real estate development and construction loans
home equity loans and lines of credit
segments.description: A full-service community commercial bank providing banking, lending, mortgage and wealth management services to customers in Pennsylvania and Maryland.
segments.evidence: ACNB Bank is a full-service commercial bank operating under charter from the Pennsylvania Department of Banking and Securities.

segments.name: ACNB Insurance Services
segments.evidence: ACNB Insurance Services is managed separately from the Bank and is reported as a separate operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Bank interest and fees on loans, deposit and wealth management service fees, and insurance clients pay premiums and commissions to the insurance agency.
revenueModel.evidence: Commercial lending includes commercial mortgages, real estate development and construction loans, accounts receivable and inventory financing, and agricultural and governmental loans.

changes.text: In 2025, ACNB acquired Traditions Bancorp, Inc. and merged Traditions Bank into ACNB Bank.
changes.evidence: Effective February 1, 2025, ACNB closed the acquisition of Traditions Bancorp, Inc., holding company for Traditions Bank, York, Pennsylvania.
